compatibility.rule: Existing canonical labels retain their original spelling and meaning. Consumers must not silently project legacy labels into v2 labels.

axisSemantics.regions: Where the node appears in the rendered page. Multiple labels may be observed.
axisSemantics.purposes: What the node does for a user. Multiple labels may be observed.
axisSemantics.componentType: The observed component shape. It is one Choice value, independent of region and purpose.
axisSemantics.pageTypes: The page primary purpose. It is independent of node labels.
axisSemantics.contentKinds: The primary content presented by a page. It is independent of page type.

observationSemantics.omittedOrEmpty: This axis was not observed; it is never evidence that every label is negative.
observationSemantics.unknown: Only the literal unknown singleton denotes an explicit unknown observation for one multi-label axis.

regions.article_body: Long-form prose body of one editorial article or news story, below its article header.
regions.advertisement: Area reserved for paid or sponsored third-party advertising, not first-party promotion.
regions.product_gallery: Visual gallery for one product, including images, video, thumbnails, or alternate views.
regions.product_buy_box: Purchase-focused area for one product with price, availability, variants, or buy controls.
regions.product_details: Product description, attributes, dimensions, or technical specifications area.
regions.product_reviews: Ratings, review summaries, or individual reviews area for one product.
regions.author_bio: Author byline, biography, credentials, or profile area associated with editorial content.
regions.related_content: Area recommending related articles, products, resources, or next items after primary content.
regions.comments: Area containing reader, user, or community comments and replies.

purposes.advertising: Paid or sponsored third-party advertising; distinct from the site's own promotion.
purposes.purchase: Starts or completes a purchase, such as add to cart, variant choice, or checkout.
purposes.media_playback: Starts, pauses, seeks, controls, or presents audio or video playback.
purposes.review: Lets a user read, write, submit, or evaluate ratings and reviews.
purposes.information: Explains factual information without being instructional, promotional, or an interaction control.
purposes.editorial: Presents authored reporting, analysis, opinion, or narrative editorial content.
purposes.instruction: Teaches a task, procedure, or workflow through directions or steps.
purposes.product_information: Explains a product's features, attributes, compatibility, or specifications apart from purchase controls.
purposes.comparison: Compares alternatives, plans, products, or options to help evaluate a choice.
purposes.social_proof: Provides endorsements, testimonials, ratings, or other evidence of others' approval.

componentTypes.ad_unit: Paid or sponsored advertising creative or container; not a first-party promotional banner.
componentTypes.media_gallery: Coordinated gallery or carousel of multiple visual media items; a single item remains image or media.
componentTypes.purchase_panel: Grouped product purchase area with price, availability, variant, add-to-cart, or buy controls.
componentTypes.specification_list: Structured list or table of attributes, dimensions, technical details, or specifications.
componentTypes.rating_summary: Compact rating, score, stars, or review-count presentation for one item.
componentTypes.review_list: Collection of individual customer, user, or editorial review entries for one item.
componentTypes.video_player: Interactive video player or embedded viewing surface, including controls.
componentTypes.audio_player: Interactive audio player or embedded listening surface, including controls.
componentTypes.author_card: Compact author identity or biography unit with an author name, image, credentials, or profile link.
componentTypes.comment_thread: Threaded or chronological collection of reader, user, or community comments and replies.
